title: Market at Close | Sensex, Nifty slip amid volatility; Midcaps fall 1% - CNBC TV18
content: On Tuesday, October 14, 2025, the BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty closed lower amid heightened market volatility, failing to sustain early gains. The Nifty ended 82 points lower at 25,146, after fluctuating between 25,100 and 25,300 during the session, while the Sensex declined 297 points to close at 82,030. The Bank Nifty slipped 129 points to 56,496. Market breadth weakened, with the Nifty Midcap index falling nearly 1% (438 points) to 58,324, and the NSE advance-decline ratio standing at 1:3, indicating broad-based selling. Sectoral performance was mixed: IT stocks ended mixed, with Wipro as the top gainer and TCS subdued; hospital stocks rose, led by Max Healthcare, which gained 1%. On the downside, Dr Reddy's Laboratories, Bharat Electronics, Bajaj Finance, and NTPC declined up to 2%. Vodafone Idea fell another 4%, Indus Towers ended lower, GAIL dropped 3% due to opposition to its proposed tariff hike, and Dixon Technologies fell over 3% after a brokerage report flagged potential guidance miss. In midcaps, MCX surged 5% on improved trading data, IREDA rose 3% after positive Q2 results, and Sona BLW advanced 4% after recovering from early losses. ICICI Prudential Life Insurance closed nearly 1% higher on mixed Q2 earnings, while The Leela fell 5% and Bank of Maharashtra declined nearly 4% post-Q2 announcements.

title: Stock market holiday: Is US stock market closed or open today for Labor Day 2025? | Stock Market News
content: The United States stock markets will remain closed on Monday, 1 September 2025, in observance of Labor Day, according to the official holiday list of the Nasdaq Stock Exchange and the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). Because the market is closed on Saturday and Sunday, there is no half‑day trading session preceding the holiday. Official NYSE data indicates that only two other holidays will occur in 2025: Thanksgiving on 27 November and Christmas on 25 December. The S&P 500 closed 0.64% lower at 6,460.26 points on Friday, down from 6,501.86 points at the previous close. The Nasdaq Composite fell 1.15% to 21,455.55 points, compared with 21,705.16 points previously. On the Dow Jones Industrial Average, UnitedHealth Group Inc., American Express Co., Merck & Co., Johnson & Johnson, Coca‑Cola Co., Walmart Inc., Procter & Gamble Co., and Chevron Corp. were the top gainers, while Caterpillar Inc., Nvidia Corp., 3M Co., Amazon.com Inc., and IBM were the top laggards. For the S&P 500, Autodesk Inc., Cooper Cos., J.M. Smucker Co., Monila Healthcare Inc., Brown‑Forman Corp., Eastman Chemical Co., and Kraft Heinz Co. gained, whereas Dell Technologies Inc., Ulta Beauty Inc., Oracle Corp., and Super Micro Computer Inc. lagged. On the Nasdaq, Professional Diversity Network Inc., Movano Inc., Gamehaus Holdings Inc., Fangdd Holdings Inc., and Next Technologies Holding Inc. were the top gainers, while Cycurion Inc., CaliberCos Inc., VSee Health Inc., and Outlook Therapeutics were among the top losers.

title: 和讯投顾潘榕榕：可依据尾盘行情，判断次日股价走势-新闻频道-和讯网
content: According to Pan Rongrong, a consultant at Hexun, the closing price of a stock can be used to predict the next day's price trend. If the stock price is volatile throughout the day and then rises at the end of the trading day, it indicates that the main force has been observing the market all day and is building up positions at the end of the day, which means the stock price is likely to rise sharply the next day. If the stock price suddenly drops at the end of the trading day and forms a long upper shadow, it suggests that the main force is performing regular operations, and the stock price is likely to rise in the next few trading days. If the stock price breaks through at the end of the trading day and is in a state of consolidation, with a large increase in trading volume, it indicates that the main force has completed its position-building and the stock price is likely to rise significantly. If the stock price is volatile throughout the day and then reverses and rises above the trend line at the end of the trading day, it suggests that the main force is building up positions. Pan Rongrong said, 'These are the four possible scenarios that can be used to predict the next day's price trend based on the closing price.'
